headline: Kuura Strand Reopens; Wardens Recover Ground in Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Three hours on, the northern line has shifted again. Kuura Strand, silent at the last edition, has flared anew with five actions in two hours; the strand now reads three Warden works, two Colonial and one unclaimed, with 306 Colonial and 267 Warden casualties in the last two hours and 1,479 against 994 across the day. In the Weathered Expanse the Wardens have taken a work from Colonial hands, leaving four Warden, two Colonial and three neutral, though the fighting about Spirit Watch and Frostmarch has tapered to three actions in two hours from fifty-five in the day, the day's losses standing at 7,034 Colonial and 8,729 Warden. Fresh fires are reported along the Nevish Line, four actions in two hours centred on Tomb Father, where the day's toll is 2,082 Colonial and 1,462 Warden. Linn Mercy remains hot about Outwich Ranch, two actions in the last two hours and sixteen in the day, and Pari Peak reports three at Pariah. Farranac Coast and the Gutter have gone quiet after heavy days. Heaviest slaughter continues at Callahan's Passage, 6,401 Colonial and 4,765 Warden fallen in a day without ground changing hands, and at Stonecradle, 3,655 against 5,720. Colonials hold 312 works to the Warden 108, with nine unclaimed.
